scene: A quiet home play corner. Dad kneels screen-left and Child kneels screen-right on a rug, directly in front of a low shelf that both can reach without climbing. Child is the same four-year-old tiger boy in a yellow T-shirt, navy shorts and cream socks throughout. One small red toy car with black wheels rests at the back-right of the shelf behind a small opaque blue storage box. The box blocks Child's initial view of the car; the car is already there and stays there until retrieved in the final clip. The shelf has clear space immediately to the box's left so Dad can slide it sideways without pushing the car. The car and its single box obstacle are the only movable props. Lock a 16:9 medium two-shot including both faces, hands, the rug and the whole low shelf. No second car, other room or search montage.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Dad notices an ordinary search and listens with relaxed posture.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child may look mildly puzzled while searching, a brief thinking look while remembering, then a small smile of recognition. Dad responds with one gentle point and a small acknowledging smile.
emotion.forbidden: No frantic searching, alarm, theatrical guessing, exaggerated discovery, shouting, jumping, grabbing or distorted expressions.

clips.start: Dad kneels screen-left and Child screen-right beside the low shelf; both have empty hands. Child looks over the empty rug. The blue box stands at the shelf's front-right, hiding the stationary red car with black wheels at the back-right. Child wears his yellow T-shirt, navy shorts and cream socks.
clips.action: Dad notices Child searching the rug and asks what is missing. Child looks up, asks about his red car and mentions having it at story time. Dad asks where he played with it last. Child remembers the rug and putting it near the shelf, glancing from the rug to the low shelf during his answer. Neither character touches the box or car.
clips.end: Dad kneels screen-left and Child screen-right, both looking at the front of the low shelf with empty hands. The blue box is still at the front-right, hiding the red car with black wheels at the back-right; the clear shelf space to the box's left is empty. Child's outfit is unchanged.

clips.start: Dad kneels screen-left and Child screen-right, both looking at the front of the low shelf with empty hands. The blue box is still at the front-right, hiding the red car with black wheels at the back-right; the clear shelf space to the box's left is empty. Child's outfit is unchanged.
clips.action: Dad narrows the search with a short point toward the blue box, then lowers his hand. Child studies the gap behind the box and offers his guess that the car might be behind the blue box, with a brief thinking look. Keep the car concealed and stationary; no successful search or prop movement happens before the final clip.
clips.end: Dad and Child remain kneeling screen-left and screen-right, now looking toward the space behind the blue box with empty hands. The blue box remains at the shelf's front-right, the red car with black wheels is hidden at the back-right, and the space to the box's left is clear. Child's outfit is unchanged.

clips.start: Dad and Child remain kneeling screen-left and screen-right, now looking toward the space behind the blue box with empty hands. The blue box remains at the shelf's front-right, the red car with black wheels is hidden at the back-right, and the space to the box's left is clear. Child's outfit is unchanged.
clips.action: During his opening turn Dad uses his right hand to slide the blue box a short distance left into the already clear shelf space, visibly revealing the red car without touching it. Child recognizes the car, reaches with his right hand and lifts that same car from the back-right of the shelf, reporting where it was. Dad acknowledges the find with a small smile while Child brings it close. Dad releases the box and returns his right hand to his lap. These small actions overlap the speech; neither character stands or starts another game.
clips.end: Child kneels screen-right holding the single red car with black wheels in his right hand, with his left hand free. Dad kneels screen-left with empty hands. The blue box now stands farther left on the low shelf and the car's former back-right spot is empty. Child's yellow T-shirt, navy shorts and cream socks are unchanged.
